paper.excerpt: We study a modiﬁed version of MNIST where images are rotated in 10 degree increments, from 0 to 130 degrees.
We use only 108 training data points for each of the 2 smallest domains (120 and 130 degrees), and 324 points each for rotations 90 to 110, whereas the overall training set contains 32292 points.
